Ryan scanned the endless white room, muttering, “So, I’m dead, huh? This is a new world… First thing, get strong. And maybe get some beauties...…
saving-the-abandoned-empress:
All her life, Eleanora did everything to make him love her but in the end, what she got from him was her execution for a sin that she never did.
Before dying, Eleanora coldly stared at his bloody red eyes as he lifted up the sword to execute her…
“I will never forgive you for killing me and my child.”
For the first time in her life, She saw his anxious gaze.
But it was too late as the sword in his hands had already landed on her neck, separating it from her body.
Eleanora finally thought everything was over but then she opened her eyes again, to find herself back in 12 years in the past when all the misfortune was yet to happen.
She was firm to change her tragic ending this time but it was not only her who changed…
“Even if you hate me, you can only be mine in your every life… My Empress.”.....
sorcerers-handbook:
In 1668, our city earned the title of “The Safest Place in the Country.”
I had a lot to do with that. How?
Because I was arrested.
sorcerers-shadow:
In a realm where magic entwines with conspiracy and tradition challenges power, an unexpected hero arises, not from the illustrious ranks of the Imperion nobility, but from the oft-overlooked Terrans—humans. Welcome to the world of Viktor Dravos, a saga that morphs the traditional fantasy narrative into an exhilarating journey of adventure, cunning, and introspective dilemmas.
Viktor Dravos—assassin, wizard, and reluctant gentleman—is your unconventional protagonist, navigating the precarious intricacies of Imperion society. As a member of the House of Vorgan, the secretive underworld of the Kingdom, Viktor is privy to the hidden threads that manipulate the core of Imperion politics.
starting-today-ill-work-as-a-city-lord:
Lucas unexpectedly possessed the ability to travel between Earth and a new world. The new world is a fantasy world without magic but it have all kind of people like Elf, Beastkins.
Read the story of Lucas how he start his journey by becoming a City Lord in this world. With his harem of beastkins.
I am not only translating it but also adding my own imagination in the novel. This is a fanfic.
Important: The MC is not chaotic evil. He is ruthless toward his enemies.
summoning-players-into-my-game:
Lin Qi is an ordinary young man who suddenly arrives in a martial arts world and finds that he owns nothing but an abandoned Martial Arts Hall, which has been desolate for an untold number of years, and a Martial Arts Transmission System capable of summoning players.
Using players as chess pieces, Lin Qi's life of puppeteer begins behind the scenes.
“100% real virtual game, do you want to play?”
“Battle of the Myriad Races, experience the most realistic epic battlefield, do you want to play?”
“Get stronger in the game, and you will become stronger in reality too, just ask if you want to play?”
the-bastard-son-of-the-dragon-god:
Born with a dragon's destructive fury and the forbidden arts of Golden Magic, he was never meant to survive. Raised in secret by human royals, the illegitimate heir to the tyrant 18th Dragon God hides his deadly heritage behind a charming smile.
To protect his adoptive family, he must do the unthinkable: infiltrate the ruthless Dragon Academy. Surrounded by elite heirs who would execute him if they discovered his true bloodline, he plays a dangerous game of survival. But the empire's brutal conquests are driven by a horrifying truth—a Multiversal War is coming, and only a unified, iron-fisted galaxy can survive it. He cannot just tear down the throne; he must claim it and forge a better weapon.
Every rival defeated and every secret uncovered draws the gaze of the god who wants him dead. As the cosmos prepares to shatter, his feral instincts battle his humanity. Can he reform an empire built on cosmic slaughter, or will his power burn the universe before the enemy even arrives?
the-ceos-wife-is-super-charming:
In her past life, Liu Qi was still a virgin after three years of her marriage. Her husband had chased her out of the house for the sake of his mistress. Liu Qi wandered the streets with her frail body. When mind-crushing darkness overtook her vision and she fell, a pair of large hands grabbed her in time.
“Don’t be afraid. I’ll take you home. I won’t let go anymore.” It was him, Shen Nanxiao. So he had been in love with her all this while. Yet, her life was beginning to trickle away like an hourglass. ‘If there is a next life, I will love you properly this time.’
After being reborn, Liu Qi was a crying mess as she stared at the man in front of her. Liu Qi hugged him tight and said through tears, “No, Shen Nanxiao, don’t you leave me. I don’t hate you. I don’t hate you. I like you.” “What?!” Shen Nanxiao thought he had heard wrongly. He hugged her tight and whispered into her ear, “You’ve just lost the chance to leave.”
the-holy-maiden-uncovers-my-coffin-when-:
Yang Yan found himself becoming a corpse. But before he could stay for a minute, the lid of his coffin was opened.
A stunning face appeared in front of him.
Leng Biyue!
As the Holy Maiden of the Fairy Maiden Sect, she possessed the quasi-empire bloodline!
Blood spilled from the corner of her mouth, fell, and landed on Yang Yan's face.
His eyes opened!
“The Sword Dao Emperor, who was buried for 100,000 years, has come to life once again!”
the-immortals-poison:
This is the story of the youth Wen Leyang, born into the family with an expertise in the cultivation of the Art of Poison.
The enemy may not always be evil, and neither does someone evil necessarily be the enemy. However, one thing is certain. Wen Leyang is a frank and honest young man, a delightful hero who posseses a kind disposition towards any living creature.
Learn about his journey as he embarks on an adventure of cultivating into an immortal.
the-master-of-beasts:
Chen Jiuge is a transmigrator in a world of cultivation, who, with the help of an ability to extract bloodlines from different species, continuously creates mythical beasts.
“Wow, this chicken actually has a trace of dragon bloodline, great, first buy a hundred thousand to craft a dragon for fun.”
“Wow, this rabbit actually has the bloodline of the moon rabbit, buy a hundred thousand to craft a moon rabbit.”
the-overbearing-chief-husbands-favorite-:
He is a legendary business powerhouse, a King with a business empire. She is just an ordinary female student. A deal, – a paper marriage, a marriage for four years. Four years later, she turned away fearlessly. She thought that their path would never cross again, but he took her in his stride and refused to let go of everything about her, even interfering with her getting close to other men!
“Luo Yibei, we’ve already divorced! We’re finished! Over!”
“Yeah?”
She had to ask what he meant.
And he shoved a small bun in her bosom with a look of disapproval.
the-reader-and-protagonist-definitely-ha:
An internet troll who wanted attention, the reader criticized his favorite web novel, saying: “The protagonist is dumb and the author is stupid.”
Author: “… Got it.”
Unfortunately for him, the author actually listened to his (troll) feedback. The formerly lighthearted tale of a cute harem master suddenly became super dark and edgy. The reader could only helplessly look on as the the protagonist was abused and betrayed, finally embarking on the road to becoming completely evil. Everything was a mess!
After that the reader transmigrated into a strange world. How come the person in front of him looks like the protagonist (evil undead version)? Just what is going on?!
Note: Du Zhe (读者 meaning Reader) and Du Ze (杜泽 the character’s name) sound almost the same
the-villain-has-something-to-say:
As the head disciple of the number one sect in the world, Luo Jianqing had a brilliant reputation. He was the most respected senior brother of his junior brothers and sisters: the last disciple of the cultivation world’s number one cultivator, Luo Jianqing greatly respected his master’s teachings, not crossing his limits by even half a step.
Afterwards…… he was stabbed to death just like that by the main character with his sword. His master’s sword.
Luo Jianqing: “……”
The heavens wants me dead, yet I refuse to die! See if the will of the heavens is more fearsome, or if the will of my sword is more stubborn!
Wu Yin: “Jianqing, I have something to say to you.”
Luo Jianqing: “Master, I also have something to say to you.”
Wu Yin: “… you speak first?”
Luo Jianqing: “You speak first.”
Wu Yin: “I like you.” / Luo Jianqing: “I want to top you.”
Wu Yin: “……”
the-villain-who-robbed-the-heroines:
When I read the development of the heroine getting stolen away, I left a malicious comment to the author.
But then I woke up later, and I’m now the villain who is supposed to steal the heroine.
unsealing-emptiness:
He was not a human since no human is aware of himself even before his birth.
He has no blood and no heart, but emotions?
He does have feelings, but can he express them?
Why was he called a Devil’s Spawn at his birth?
Why did they cut away his arms and a leg?
Why did no one ever visit him for years?
And why does this emptiness... feels so... just so familiar?
Why does the Void feel so... full?
Who is he? Or rather... What is he?
when-god-decides-to-start-over:
Mysterious gates appeared all around the world a few decades ago. Beings emerged from the gates and brought disaster upon humanity. Humanity called them Demon Spirits. It wasn’t until the advent of Demon Suits and Demon Suiters that humans stood a fighting chance.
For some perplexing reason, the world’s number one Demon Suiter, Li “God” Xiu abandons his identity to start over again as a newbie trial-taker. He enters the gates to participate in all sorts of trials, in a bid to seek out the reason that enticed his best friend into becoming a trial-taker.
These trials weren't the run-of-the-mill dungeons, ranging from game sports (soccer, basketball, baseball, etc) to athletics. Just as fortune favors the brave, what would Li Xiu obtain on his quest?
“Are you telling me he’s a greenhorn?” the other trial-takers frustratingly ask while watching Li Xiu's feats that prove why he's the number one Demon Suiter.
